TEXT: That night---
While everyone was sleeping, late in the night...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Kuh... Shackling me with a 50/50 mixup...! How can she manage that!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Nnnh... Noisy...
The voice is too loud. No way I can fall asleep...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You! You! Youuu!
She clearly exceeded the boundaries of talking to oneself... Grrrr...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: That malicious girl!
Ah... She's probably practicing "Siscaly" online with Kuroneko...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hah?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Who do you think you are?!
Even quarreling while on the net...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Who does she think she is?! In-fu-riating!
I have a really bad feeling... Should I fake being asleep?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hey!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ......ZZZZZZ

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Tch, he's asleep. In that case...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I get it... I'm getting up now, I'm getting up...
...What was she going to do to her sleeping brother?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: It's so infuriating!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...W-What is?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I want to kick that black one from our group.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Come to my room for a moment.
I expected this would happen...
The monitor in Kirino's room is displaying Siscaly.
The decided victor of the two -- the character Kuroneko uses.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I can't deny that this girl has an exceptional reaction time and the ability to accurately read her opponent.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: With such skills, it's obvious anyone would lose against her!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: And also... you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Anyway, it pisses me off!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hah...
So she got thrashed by Kuroneko and was unable to take it, so she's venting her anger by trying to get Kuroneko off the tournament...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't be so rash. If Kuroneko is so skillful, that's all the more reasons not to kick her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: But, she actually said about me: "To give up so many frames, is your brain clogged up by all that fashion mongering?"

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: And also...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: N-Nothing...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm... I don't know what's going on, but I'm sure it's a matter on a whole other level.
Looks like Kuroneko's words hurt her greatly, her eyes are welling with tears...
What did she do to Kirino? She's definitely taking it too far...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Rest assured, Kirino! You're strong! You must have some confidence!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Keep quiet.
So this is what you say to a "caring brother who encourages his sister"...
No, it's okay. I don't really mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Anyway, I'm gonna kick that black one out...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: However, if you say that, you'll end up regretting it, right?
No matter how bad our relationship, an elder brother is still an elder brother.
At the very least, I know what my sister is thinking just by looking at her face.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Well, I...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...I know her skill at games. It bothers me, but if she doesn't take part in the tournament, it will be problematic and besides...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Besides...? What?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...I said it to her...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Said what?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I'm kicking you out of the tournament...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ouch...
Kirino isn't the kind of sister that would say, "I want to join the tournament with my friends." I know this perfectly well.
She can't accept this kind of situation, but she can't solve the problem herself.
To do something to resolve this, is that the job of an elder brother?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Anyway, you must do something to 【increase our chances of victory】...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Since we've already taken up the challenge, I want to win, no matter what it takes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Then, just apologizing would be fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Me? Isn't she the one at fault?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Who cares who's right or wrong... In a quarrel, both sides have their responsibilities; no one is right or wrong.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You... Do something.
